N+1 DATABASE QUERY

app/database.py · Line 42

The application performs an additional database query for every user in the result set. Database load scales linearly with user count.

before — app/database.py:42
# ⚠ N+1: one extra query per user
for user in users:
    user.orders = get_orders(user.id)
QUERY SCALING
1 user→1 query
100 users→100 queries
1,000 users→1,000 queries
WHY THIS MATTERS
More users ↓ More DB queries ↓ Higher response time ↓ Lower capacity
